    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    background = grid[0][0]

    # Find interior targets (non-background in rows 1..last-2)

                       for c in range(1, cols-1) if grid[r][c] != background]
    
    # Process each interior target
